items.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: I think Blue was on that too, wasn’t he? Didn’t Blue do, wasn’t Blue Mitchell on that?

ctx.x: That was a good record. It really was a good record. I think one of the best parts about that record was Richie Kamuca, who I’ve always been a big fan of Richie’s. And of course Marshall too, and I think Blue was on that too, wasn’t he? Didn’t Blue do, wasn’t Blue Mitchell on that?
Actually this recording is from, I think it’s a live—
